Initial release of muslim-holiday-calendar skill.

- Calculate major Islamic holidays (Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Ramadan, etc.) for years 2024–2030.
- Hijri-Gregorian date conversion included.
- Countdown to next Islamic holiday.
